settings.subs.hint: Style, secondary subtitle and translation. Changes apply to the player at once.
settings.subs.fonts_dir_hint: Copy TTF or OTF files into this folder: ASS tracks that use them render with the right font, and they appear in the font list.
settings.subs.fonts_none: No fonts in the folder yet
settings.subs.provider_hint: Google works without a key. DeepL, Azure and OpenAI-compatible servers use your own key.
settings.subs.endpoint_hint: Base URL of the server; for OpenAI-compatible servers /v1/chat/completions is added when missing.
settings.subs.model_hint: Model name the server expects (for example gpt-4o-mini or llama3).
settings.subs.region_hint: Region of your Translator resource (for example westeurope).
settings.subs.key_hint: Stored in the system keychain, never in the settings file.
settings.subs.key_hint_deepl: Keys ending in :fx use the free DeepL API. Stored in the system keychain.
settings.subs.key_hint_optional: Optional: local servers (Ollama, LM Studio) need none. Stored in the system keychain.
settings.subs.key_failed: The key could not be stored
settings.subs.target_hint: Language the subtitles are translated into.
settings.subs.live_hint: Each line is translated as it shows. Works with text subtitles (SRT, VTT, ASS).
settings.subs.pretranslate_hint: Translates the whole external track when an episode starts, then plays it without delay.
settings.subs.test_hint: Translates a sample sentence with the settings above.
settings.subs.cache_hint: Translated lines are kept so a re-watch does not ask the engine again.
settings.subs.cache_failed: The cache could not be cleared: {detail}
subs.sheet.title: Subtitles
subs.sheet.no_player: The player is not ready yet: changes are saved and applied when the video starts.
subs.tracks.none: This stream has no subtitle tracks. Load a file below.
subs.file.failed: The subtitle file could not be loaded
subs.secondary.hint: A second track shown at the top of the picture, for example to learn a language.
subs.style.sample: This is how your subtitles will look.
subs.translate.off_hint: Choose a translation engine in Settings > Subtitles to translate subtitles.
subs.translate.done: Ready: {label} is now the active track
subs.translate.internal_only: Only text subtitles can be translated: this track is embedded as images. Pre-translation needs an external track (SRT, VTT, ASS).
subs.translate.already_target: The available subtitles are already in the target language
subs.translate.failed: The track could not be translated
